content: Original curator paraphrase of the primary cTrader Donchian reference: channel boundaries are the highest high and lowest low over a chosen period, with their midpoint forming the middle line. A close beyond a boundary can identify a possible breakout, while historical dependence introduces delay and choppy markets can produce false breakouts. This supplement's prior-twenty-bar channel, frozen breakout level and later retest within three closed bars are separate lab hypotheses; the reference does not qualify that combined rule or promise profits.
